name: dsea1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view cross-section of a prehistoric sea like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO animals, NO fish and NO people: a thin strip of light blue sky with one soft white cloud at the very top, a wavy sea surface line just below it, then a big area of calm teal blue water getting deeper blue towards the bottom, a few tall swaying brown kelp and feathery sea lilies on long stalks at the sides, some round rocks, and a flat sandy sea floor across the bottom of the picture running from the left edge to the right edge.
